units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:2">Lev. R. s. 30</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 16:11">Ps. XVI, 11</cite>) <he>הודיעני איזה פ׳ מפולש וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>תודיעני באיזה</he>) let me know which is the open gate leading to life everlasting.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 59">Gen. R. s. 59</cite>, [read as:] <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 103:1">Yalk. ib. 103</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 24:1">Gen. XXIV, 1</cite>) <he>בא בפ׳ מפולש וכ׳</he> he had entered on the gateway leading &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 66">Gen. R. s. 66</cite>, end <he>פִּילְיוֹנוֹ של וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="Q02191"><he>פו׳</he></cite>) Isaac’s gateway was open from both sides, so that the one came in from one side, and the other from the other side; [<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 66">ib.</cite> s. 48 <he>פלן של אבינו אברהם וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 82">Yalk. ib. 82</cite> <he>פוולונו</he> (corr. acc., or <cite ref="Q01413"><he>פָּפִילְיוֹנוֹ</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01413"><he>פָּפִילְיוֹן</he></cite>].

R. s. 18</cite> <he>הכל נכנסין בפ׳ אחד</he> (not <he>בפולין</he>, <he>בפילין</he>) all enter town by the same gateway [or read: <he>בפילי אחת</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00695"><he>פִּילי</he></cite>]; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:5">Koh.
